evidence: Modifies descriptor parsing and wallet import/spend error paths in src/script/descriptor.cpp, src/wallet/imports.cpp, and src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp.
rationale: Prevents secret key material (WIF keys, xprvs) from leaking into error messages during descriptor parsing, wallet imports, and transaction funding. As the author notes, 'the reply then carries the key into places the request may not go: an application's error log, an error reporter, a screenshot shared for help', threatening key confidentiality and fund safety.
